name: Lulu's sudden wedding night
source:
A short erotical story with Lulu and Shasha from Overlord. It's a what would have happened scenario if they had not been interrupted at the night of the first victory. It includes 8 animation loops.

[Edited from [url=https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/lulus-sudden-wedding-night]Itch.io[/url]]
